question: Which of the following is a dance form of West Bengal where there is a confluence of dancing, singing, drama and recital?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Alkap**__.

__
 
• **Alkap is a dance form of West Bengal where there is a confluence of dancing, singing, drama and recital**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
 

 **Dances**
 **Details**
 
 

 Hudo
 
 
 
• It is one of the folk dances of Gujarat.
 
• It is a dance of the Bharwad Tribe.
 
 
 
 

 Tippani 
 
 
 
• It is one of the folk dances of Gujarat.
 
• It is originated from the Chorwad and Veraval region of Saurashtra.
 
 
 
 

 Bhavai
 
 
 
• It is one of the folk theatres of Gujarat.
 
• It is originated in the 14th century.
 
• Asaita Thakur is credited for its origin.
 
 
 
 

 Alkap
 
 
 
• It is a Bengali folk popular in West Bengal.
 
• Kaap means Kavya and Aal means part of the verse.
